query: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as body_md5,p.proacl::text as acl from pg_proc p where p.oid='zoi.profile_strip(jsonb)'::regprocedure

rows.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.profile_strip(p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'zoi', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(
    (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k, v)
       FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p, '{}'::jsonb)) AS t(k, v)
      WHERE k NOT IN ('rating','rating_count','review','reviews','reviewCount',
                      'aggregateRating','score','stars','ranking','provider_stats',
                      '_enrich','_geo','_coverage')
        AND k NOT LIKE 'rating%'
        AND k NOT LIKE 'review%'),
    '{}'::jsonb);
$function$
